Initial release of full-funnel e-commerce advertising planner.

- Plan cross-channel ad campaigns for Amazon, Google, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest.
- Includes keyword research, competitor ad analysis, audience insights, and campaign structure templates.
- Guides on budget allocation, KPI targets, and platform selection for various e-commerce models.
- Generates channel-specific ad copy ideas and creative direction.
- Supports Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, eBay, TikTok Shop, WooCommerce, and standalone DTC brands.
- No API key required.
